headline.purpose: Main product and leech editorial headings.

body.purpose: Long-form Russian content and explanatory copy.

shadows.name: leech-hero-soft
shadows.purpose: Large leech editorial hero panels only.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Product state feedback, not decorative choreography.

components.name: Product Tabs
components.description: Horizontal Taiga tabs used for admin and leech section navigation.
components.css: tui-tabs { box-shadow: none; margin-bottom: -1px; margin-inline: -1.5rem; padding-inline: 1.5rem; } [tuiTab] { scroll-margin-inline: 1.5rem; }

narrative.overview: A reliable medical product interface with natural context, consistent Taiga UI patterns, and enough room for serious text.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Olive marks action, current position, and small trust signals.

rules.name: The Readability Rule
rules.body: Long article text gets the widest practical column before decoration.

dos: Do use Taiga UI patterns before custom components.
Do keep leech article pages wide on desktop.
donts: Don't make the interface look like эзотерика or miracle medicine.
Don't use marketplace discount and urgency patterns.
Don't create separate tab patterns when tui-tabs fits.
